purpose: Candidate-source feasibility plus bounded external native-pixel GT-center classifier stress test. No clinical validation or whole-slide scoring completed.

dataset.license: Original paper abstract explicitly permits non-commercial research only. No standalone license entry in ZIP.
dataset.access: Public ZIP byte-range requests returned HTTP206; full ZIP not downloaded.
dataset.reference_type: Positive and negative Ki67 tumor-cell center coordinates; no non-tumor references, nuclear outlines, patient/slide map or clinical endpoint.
dataset.existing_classifier_compatibility: Supports conditional classification of provided tumor points using fixed model and explicit native-pixel domain-shift limitations. Cannot assess detector, non-tumor sensitivity, whole-slide Ki67 or clinical validity.

resolution.microscope_vs_wsi: Primary Patherea comparative study describes microscope with camera, not WSI scanner. Do not assert 394 released WSIs.

related_candidate_findings.access: Open raw WSI archives advertised, metadata directly downloaded HTTP200. No WSI downloaded in this subtask.
related_candidate_findings.reference_type: Image-registration landmarks; no Ki67 percentage or cell-class reference in published metadata.
related_candidate_findings.existing_classifier_compatibility: Not directly scorable: no GT cell centers/Ki67 labels; 10x images differ from native Patherea pixel scale.

related_candidate_findings.license: Non-commercial research/education/personal use, attribution required, no raw or modified dataset redistribution; abstract derivative works allowed subject to terms.
related_candidate_findings.access: Grand Challenge HTTP403 in web tool, official site readable and has registration form; official GitHub also supplies direct public download links. Public official Drive folder and 77,507-byte XLSX downloaded without login. No form submitted.
related_candidate_findings.reference_type: Patient table Ki67 values: 1003 numeric fractions, 55 textual intervals/inequalities; reference scoring method and slide-level linkage not independently verified.
related_candidate_findings.existing_classifier_compatibility: H&E biopsy images cannot be passed to Ki67-IHC color classifier as equivalent measurement; no tumor-cell Ki67 point references.

related_candidate_findings.role: Clinical scoring/validation guidance, not an evaluation dataset.
related_candidate_findings.consequence: Prespecify intended use, reference scoring/training and endpoints; representative specimens and independent blinded scorers; distinguish analytical validity from clinical validity/utility. Public selected ROI classification cannot establish these.

publication_policy: Only own code, protocols, hashes, file-level manifests and aggregate derived metrics are included. No images, HDF5, cell-level coordinates/annotations/predictions, raw clinical metadata, or copied source articles are included.
